mood: Cinematic, professional, high-end editorial, precise, Swiss-inspired.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. Use italics for emphasis in select words to create an editorial feel. letter-spacing: tracking-tight.

mono.usage: Used for stats, timecodes, labels, or overlines. Uppercase and wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (py-24 to py-32 for sections) combined with sharp, tight grids.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical bento grid for portfolio items. Mix col-span-8, col-span-4 to avoid boring square walls.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radii: rounded-none everywhere. Sharp corners emphasize the cinematic frame and print magazine aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.textures: CSS noise/grain overlay spanning the entire site (opacity 0.03 to 0.05). Creates a 35mm film feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS for services section (border-r, border-b on grid items). No soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.motion: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Slow, sophisticated fade-ins on scroll (Framer Motion). Reveal animations via clip-path.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react with stroke-width 1 or 1.5. Keep them delicate.

sections_strategy.header: Crystal Glassmorphism over deep black (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Border-b border-white/10.
sections_strategy.hero: Massive typography. 'Guildwen MAROT' + 'EditGuil'. Layout: Left-aligned large text, with a subtle timecode or cinematic metadata floating on the right. Dark cinematic background overlay.
sections_strategy.showreel: Full-width edge-to-edge container (or max-w-7xl with sharp borders). Include a large play button icon.
sections_strategy.portfolio: Tetris grid. Images start grayscale and turn color on hover, OR scale slightly under a hidden overflow container.
sections_strategy.services: Grid borders pattern (1px border between items). Minimalist, heavy reliance on typography rather than icons.
sections_strategy.stats: Massive numbers in Cormorant Garamond (e.g., text-7xl), subtitles in JetBrains Mono.
sections_strategy.contact: Form inputs should be brutalist: no background, just a border-bottom (border-border focus:border-primary). Solid primary button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layout to achieve the strict asymmetric grid and editorial typography. Do NOT rely on pre-built generic cards.
Use framer-motion for elegant, slow reveal animations.
Ensure all fonts are imported correctly from Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, JetBrains Mono).
Apply 'rounded-none' strictly across the entire app to maintain the Swiss/Brutalist editorial look.
Include a global fixed noise overlay div (pointer-events-none) for the cinematic film grain.
For the contact form, use Shadcn but override styles: background transparent, border-0 border-b border-border rounded-none, ring-0 focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-primary.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
